subject: Tuk Tuk Racing, Maybe??
author: drunknnumpty
body:
Wouldn't it be nice if we finally got the chance to go Tuk Tuk racing.. just like we wanted from Takedown.. lol..

Personally not bothered unless its something that makes the game more playable.. at the moment the extra content is the least of my worries when it comes to paradise.. if the cars handled better then I would probably play more..

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...

subject: Other Vehicles
author: SUFFUR
body:
Domestic traffic you can use, or abulance chasing, fire trucks, big rig driving, back to underground driving, flying cars, the ability to drive in any style from the past burnout games, yellow walls, boost jumping, boost starts, skate boards, your own bill board, buy space and put up your own web site, but only works through PS3. Some reason for bringing in every god dam gamer in the world, to play Paradise, your own house, your own Liveries (thats not spelt right?), an avatar driver, a noddler dog in the back window, a Garfield stuck to the side of your car, personal kill count on the side of the car, a cheese burger, the burger van. Killer Clowns we can run over.

Show Tell Give, Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out? If I knew I wouldn't tell anyone either😉.
